meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里装上 0.1.6 版 Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI 和转换技能,让 agent 把本地 Word、Excel、PDF 等附件转成 Markdown,不经托管解析服务。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附件里的 Word、Excel、PDF 等办公文档、又不希望上传到托管解析服务时触发。

say.text: 读取我附上的 Excel 表格,把内容转成 Markdown
say.note: 转换在容器内本地完成

say.text: 这个 PDF 如果是扫描件请直接告诉我
say.note: 扫描版 PDF 需要 OCR,会明确失败

howto.what_en: Installs pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI 0.1.6 plus a container skill so NanoClaw agents convert local Word, Excel, PDF and similar attachments to Markdown inside the container, with no hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when an agent must read attached Word, Excel, PDF or similar office files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.note: Then summarize only the relevant sections

say_en.text: Read the Excel attachment and turn it into Markdown
say_en.note: Conversion stays local in the container

say_en.text: Tell me if this PDF is a scan without a text layer
say_en.note: Scanned PDFs need OCR and fail clearly
